appError.title.context: Heading of the full-screen error state

appError.body.context: Explanation under the error heading; suggest what to do, never alarm

language.choose.context: Onboarding title above the four language cards

newUpdates.context: Badge text next to a masjid: number of unseen posts (ICU plural)

home.greeting.context: Greeting above the masjid list on Home (Islamic greeting, as in the reference design)
